implementer.summary: Implements the work described by a spec or tickets: resolves the ticket and states its title, applies TDD at pre-agreed seams, runs the validations, commits before reporting done, and handles the corrections after a review.

dependencies.condition: When the shape of the interface under test is itself in question.
Informational reference to the review stage; entry point of the reviewer role.

reviewer.summary: Reviews the diff since a fixed point on two axes, Standards and Spec, in parallel sub-agents, and aggregates the findings without modifying code or creating commits.

sharedResources.note: Reviewer entry point; also referenced by the tdd skill as the review stage.
Shared deep-module vocabulary, referenced by the tdd skill and usable by other workflows.

projectProvided.note: Issue tracker workflow of the project under work; used to fetch tickets and specs.
Project glossary read while exploring the codebase, if it exists.
Architecture decision records respected in the area being touched.

projectProvided.reference: CODING_STANDARDS.md, CONTRIBUTING.md and other documented standards
projectProvided.note: Standards sources discovered in the reviewed repository for the Standards axis.
Project-setup skill mentioned as a fallback when no issue tracker is provided; resolved in the target project, not part of the embedded workflows.

adaptations.summary: Role separation: the implementer no longer triggers the independent review (the Controller starts the reviewer separately); skill call to tdd becomes a read-and-apply instruction of the embedded file; the implementer validates and commits before reporting done and also handles the corrections after a review.
Skill calls become read-and-apply instructions of the embedded files (codebase-design), and the code-review reference points to the embedded reviewer entry; conditional applications stay conditional.
Findings-only contract: the reviewer reports findings without modifying code or creating commits; the implementer applies the corrections.
